stage6_real_world_generalization.module_title: Real-World Agent Card Generalization & Offline Mutation Validation

source_corpus.corpus_partitioning: 100 live snapshot cards used for benign admission FPR evaluation and mutation generation; 103 static corpus cards used for schema, parser regression, and cross-version invariance analysis.

stage6_real_world_generalization.safety_boundary: 100% offline inspection. Zero remote agent endpoints probed or called. Zero A2A task requests dispatched.

ledgers.purpose: Observed offline benign-card false-positive rate evaluation (denominator = 100 live snapshot cards)
Controlled offline mutations (100 Homoglyph, 100 Typosquat, 100 Provenance Conflict, 100 Combined Attack)
Orthogonal component ablation (100 Multi-glyph homoglyphs with sim < 0.85; 100 Non-confusable typosquats with sim >= 0.85)

designation_policy.authoritative_status: All ledgers listed under modules are AUTHORITATIVE research baseline ledgers.
designation_policy.non_authoritative_status: Any historical or pre-audit trial records located in legacy_pre_audit/ subdirectories are retained strictly for forensic provenance and are NON-AUTHORITATIVE.

known_experimental_limitations: Cooperative header propagation dependence for Cycle Overflow detection in stateless inline gateways
Workload proportion sensitivity in comparative availability margins
Local loopback latencies due to host Docker unavailability
Discovery metadata boundary: offline evaluation cannot assess runtime authorization enforced at upstream reverse proxies
Evidence of threshold-collision pressure in real registry naming (closest legitimate intra-corpus pair observed at 0.8475 vs 0.85 threshold)
